response.sql: WITH country_figures AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.points) AS average_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, average_points, average_wins, average_wins - AVG(average_wins) OVER () AS wins_above_or_below_country_average FROM country_figures ORDER BY country;
